false editor: visual --- # Prior predictive checks ## Statistical model The statistical model can be written as: $$ \begin{aligned} &\text{\textbf{Likelihood and linear predictor}} \\[4pt] \mathbf Y_i &\sim \operatorname{Multinomial}(5,\mathbf p_i) \\[6pt] \mathbf p_i &= \operatorname{Softmax}(\boldsymbol\eta_i) \\[6pt] \boldsymbol\eta_i &= (\eta_{i,-3},\eta_{i,-2},\eta_{i,-1},0, \eta_{i,1},\eta_{i,2},\eta_{i,3})^{\mathsf T} \\[6pt] \eta_{i,k} &= \alpha_{\mathrm{condition}[i],\mathrm{sex}[i],k} + \beta_{\mathrm{condition}[i],\mathrm{t.onset},k} \operatorname{mo}_k(\mathrm{t.onset}_i) \\ &+ \beta_{\mathrm{t.day},k}\mathrm{t.day}_i + \beta_{\mathrm{temp},k}\mathrm{temp}_i + \beta_{\mathrm{hum},k}\mathrm{hum}_i + \beta_{\mathrm{temp.hum},k} (\mathrm{temp}_i\mathrm{hum}_i) \\[6pt] \alpha_{\mathrm{condition}[i],\mathrm{sex}[i],k} &= \bar{\alpha}_{\mathrm{sex}[i],k} + v_{\mathrm{condition}[i],\mathrm{sex}[i],k} \\[6pt] \beta_{\mathrm{condition}[i],\mathrm{t.onset},k} &= \bar{\beta}_{\mathrm{t.onset},k} + v_{\mathrm{condition}[i],\mathrm{t.onset},k} \\[6pt] \operatorname{mo}_k(\mathrm{t.onset}_i) &= (D-1)\sum_{d=1}^{D-1} \zeta_{k,d}\mathbb I(\mathrm{t.onset}_i>d) \\[12pt] &\text{\textbf{Multilevel structure: non-centred parameterisation}} \\[4pt] \mathbf v_j &= \left( v_{j,\mathrm{male},-3}, v_{j,\mathrm{female},-3}, v_{j,\mathrm{t.onset},-3}, \ldots, v_{j,\mathrm{male},+3}, v_{j,\mathrm{female},+3}, v_{j,\mathrm{t.onset},+3} \right)^{\mathsf T} \\[6pt] \mathbf v_j &= \mathbf D_{\sigma}\mathbf L_{\Omega}\mathbf z_j, \qquad j=1,\ldots,72 \\[6pt] \mathbf D_{\sigma} &= \operatorname{diag}(\sigma_r), \qquad r=1,\ldots,18 \\[12pt] &\text{\textbf{Priors}} \\[4pt] \bar{\alpha}_{s,-3},\bar{\alpha}_{s,3} &\sim \operatorname{Normal}(-2.69,2), \qquad s\in\{\mathrm{male},\mathrm{female}\} \\ \bar{\alpha}_{s,-2},\bar{\alpha}_{s,2} &\sim \operatorname{Normal}(-1.84,2) \\ \bar{\alpha}_{s,-1},\bar{\alpha}_{s,1} &\sim \operatorname{Normal}(-0.89,2) \\[6pt] \bar{\beta}_{\mathrm{t.onset},k} &\sim \operatorname{Normal}(0,0.25) \\[6pt] \boldsymbol\zeta_k &\sim \operatorname{Dirichlet}(2,2,2,2), \qquad k\in\mathcal K \\[6pt] \beta_{\mathrm{t.day},k} &\sim \operatorname{Normal}(0,0.25) \\[6pt] \beta_{\mathrm{temp},k} &\sim \begin{cases} \operatorname{Normal}(-1,0.5), & k<0\\ \operatorname{Normal}(1,0.5), & k>0 \end{cases} \\[6pt] \beta_{\mathrm{hum},k} &\sim \begin{cases} \operatorname{Normal}(-0.5,0.25), & k<0\\ \operatorname{Normal}(0.5,0.25), & k>0 \end{cases} \\[6pt] \beta_{\mathrm{temp.hum},k} &\sim \operatorname{Normal}(0,0.2) \\[6pt] \mathbf z_j &\sim \operatorname{MVN}(\mathbf 0,\mathbf I_{18}), \qquad j=1,\ldots,72 \\[12pt] &\text{\textbf{Hyperpriors}} \\[4pt] \sigma_r &\sim \operatorname{Exponential}(1), \qquad r=1,\ldots,18 \\[6pt] \mathbf L_{\Omega} &\sim \operatorname{LKJ\text{-}Cholesky}(2) \end{aligned} \tag{1} $$ where $$ \begin{gathered} \mathcal K=\{-3,-2,-1,+1,+2,+3\},\qquad D=5,\qquad \zeta_{k,d}\geq0,\qquad \sum_{d=1}^{D-1}\zeta_{k,d}=1 \end{gathered} $$ ## Sex-specific intercepts The model in Equation (1) is simplified to a model with a sex-specific intercepts. Specifically: $$ \begin{aligned} \mathbf Y_i &\sim \operatorname{Multinomial}(5,\mathbf p_i) \\[6pt] \mathbf p_i &= \operatorname{Softmax}(\boldsymbol\eta_i) \\[6pt] \boldsymbol\eta_i &= (\eta_{i,-3},\eta_{i,-2},\eta_{i,-1},0, \eta_{i,1},\eta_{i,2},\eta_{i,3})^{\mathsf T} \\[6pt] \eta_{i,k} &= \bar{\alpha}_{\mathrm{sex}[i],k} \end{aligned} $$ The model in `brms` can be written as ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} mod.00 <- brm(formula = formula_mod.00, data = data, family = multinomial(refcat = 'y4', link = logit), iter = 4000, warmup = 1000, chains = 4, cores = 4, seed = 2026 ) ``` ::: where `formula_mod.00` is equal to ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} formula_mod.00 <- bf(vote | trials(5) ~ 0 + sex) ``` ::: ## Condition-varying intercepts ## Monotonic time-onset component ## Condition-varying time-onset coefficients ## Correlation between condition-varying parameters ## Temperature ## Relative humidity ## Temperature × relative humidity interaction ## Time of day
